name: ankai
description: AnkAI monorepo. This root package exists only to boot the gateway, the four services and the frontend together in development - each of those keeps its own package.json and dependencies.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "gateway,auth,chat,agent,billing,front" --prefix-colors "cyan,green,yellow,magenta,blue,gray" "npm --prefix backend/gateway run dev" "npm --prefix backend/services/auth run dev" "npm --prefix backend/services/chat run dev" "npm --prefix backend/services/agent run dev" "npm --prefix backend/services/billing run dev" "npm --prefix front run dev"
scripts.dev:backend: concurrently --names "gateway,auth,chat,agent,billing" --prefix-colors "cyan,green,yellow,magenta,blue" "npm --prefix backend/gateway run dev" "npm --prefix backend/services/auth run dev" "npm --prefix backend/services/chat run dev" "npm --prefix backend/services/agent run dev" "npm --prefix backend/services/billing run dev"
